values.note: Book through the city's Rec1 catalog or by phone. No refunds on cancellation. Hookups are locked until staff unlock them, so an after-hours online booking gets power and water the next day.

note: City of Winchester campground by the ball fields of the city park on Tims Ford Lake, with a boat launch, kayak put-in and dock nearby. Sites are also rented by the week, month and season. --Claude
summary: Winchester city campground: city page (bot wall, read headless) and Rec1 tab text confirm Apr 1-Oct 31, reservable online/phone, phone 931-962-4204; no rate posted anywhere official in the off-season (Rec1 lists no sites now); not waterfront kept (west end of the loop ~50 m from summer pool: lakeview candidate); pin ~150 m east of OSM's loop; Google 3.6 (29).
flags: RATE UNREAD: the Rec1 Campgrounds tab lists no sites or rates in November and the city page posts none; no Wayback capture of either. A July 2025 Campendium review says '$50 a night' (camper report, unverified; local park, not price-gated). fees left absent.

LONG-STAY MIX (local park, no gate): sites are also sold weekly, monthly (up to 2x) and 'seasonally' up to 10 months; a July 2025 Campendium review: 'Several other sites appeared to be occupied by squatters.' Nightly share unknown. The '10-month' seasonal rate contradicts the city's Apr 1-Oct 31 season - possibly a few sites stay occupied off-season.

WATERFRONT not waterfront KEPT (default down), but a lakeview/lakefront candidate: OSM maps the campground as the gravel loop in the pine wood WEST of the ball-field lot (35.2038-35.2053, -86.1356..-86.1328), not the lot itself. The loop's west end (~35.2040,-86.1352, 3DEP ~272 m) is ~50 m over open mown grass from Tims Ford's summer-pool line (888 ft = 270.7 m at 35.20355,-86.13536), where the city's 'dock adjacent to the campground' stands; the rest of the loop is 80-150 m back behind the woods and fields. No site map or site numbers exist on any operator page and the off-season imagery shows no RVs, so no named sites can carry an upgrade. If AWH wants it: 'lakeview - west end of the loop ~50 m over open grass to the summer-pool line by the city dock; sites unnumbered (Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-25)'.
